entities.summary: Anastasiia Hotfrid is a Ukrainian-born Georgian weightlifter who competes in the +75 kg division. She placed 12th at the 2015 World Championships and at the 2016 Olympics. She won a gold medal at the 2016 European Championships, and gold at the 2017 World Weightlifting Championships.
